response.sql: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), total_orders_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders FROM `order`), shares AS (SELECT ao.account_id, ao.order_count, CAST(ao.order_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total_orders FROM total_orders_count) as share FROM account_orders ao), average_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_average_accounts AS (SELECT s.account_id, s.order_count, s.share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share_value asv WHERE s.share > asv.avg_share) SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_orders, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_value)) as avg_distance_above FROM above_average_accounts
